definitions.explanation: Used with negatives to express a low degree.

examples.japanese: あまり⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧じゃない⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I don't like it very much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あまり⟦わかりません→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't understand Japanese very well.

examples.japanese: あまり⟦{食|た}べませんでした→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あまり⟦{寒|さむ}くなかった→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}びました→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: It wasn't very cold today, so we played outside.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、あまり⟦おいしくない→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すすめません→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: This shop is cheap, but the food isn't very good, so I don't recommend it to friends.

notes:
あまり is used with negative forms to mean "not very" or "not much."

GRAMMAR:
- あまり + negative: not very, not much
- Must be followed by a negative predicate

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あまり⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧じゃない: don't really like
- あまり⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: don't really understand
- あまり⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: don't use much
- あまり⟦{食|た}べない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: don't eat much

DEGREE COMPARISON:
- あまり〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not very (soft negation)
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not at all (strong negation)
- ⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: hardly, barely

Note: In casual speech, あんまり is also used.
